Master Wrapper for Blood Pressure Utilities

Source: R/bp_family.R
bp_assess.Rd

Runs bp_expected, bp_relative and bp_category in one call. Inputs are validated once and the expected BP is computed once, so messages are printed once and the results are consistent with each other.

Usage

bp_assess(bp_value, bp_limit = c(-Inf, Inf), ..., .quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

bp_value

Numeric vector of observed BP values (mmHg).

bp_limit

Length-2 numeric vector c(min, max) giving acceptable range used for categorisation. See bp_category.

...

Arguments passed on to .bp_validate_demo_input

bp_type

Character; "systolic" or "diastolic".

sex

Vector of sex codes in your data. Will be mapped to "male" or "female" using male_code and female_code. Values not matching these codes become NA.

male_code,female_code

Scalar values that identify the male and female codes in sex (e.g., 1 and 2, or "M" and "F").

height_z

Numeric vector of height z-scores. Must already be z-transformed (e.g., US CDC, UK-WHO).

height_limit

Positive numeric; z-scores with |z| > height_limit are treated as invalid and set to NA. Default 5.

age_years

Numeric vector of ages in years.

ref

Reference: "Fourth Report" (children/adolescents, 0-17) or "NICE/BHF" (adults, >17).

.quiet

Logical; suppress messages (default FALSE).

Value

A tibble with one row per input and columns expected (\(\mu\), mmHg), zscore, percentile (0-100) and category. Values that cannot be computed are NA; for ref = "NICE/BHF" only category is defined.

See also

Other BP functions: .bp_message(), .bp_resolve_limit(), .bp_validate_demo_input(), bp_category(), bp_expected(), bp_family, bp_relative()

Examples

# One-stop interface:
bp_assess(
  bp_value = c(115, 142),
  bp_type = "systolic",
  sex = c("M","F"), male_code = "M", female_code = "F",
  height_z = c(0, 0.2),
  age_years = c(13, 16),
  ref = "Fourth Report"
)
#> NHBPEP Fourth Report categorise 'Normotension' to 'Stage 2 hypertension'; Special rules for newborns (<1), children (0-12), adolescents (12-17).
#> BP outside National Paediatric Diabetes Audit (NPDA) limit removed unless acceptable range is explicitly specified by 'bp_limit'.
#> # A tibble: 2 × 4
#>   expected zscore percentile category            
#>      <dbl>  <dbl>      <dbl> <chr>               
#> 1     109.  0.581       71.9 Normotension        
#> 2     112.  2.88        99.8 Stage 2 hypertension
